node.title: Re: Challenge: sort weekdays in week-order (elegantly and efficiently)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I agree with the others that using a module like [doc://Time::Piece], [mod://DateTime], or at least [mod://Sort::Key] is the right way to go about this. But just for fun, TIMTWOTDI, and to fulfill your "[id://11145635|some kind of transform]" idea:

use List::Util qw/shuffle/; my @weekdays = shuffle qw/ Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday /; say join ", ", map { $$_[0] } sort { $$a[1] cmp $$b[1] } map { [$_, lc(substr $_,0,2)=~tr/softwarehum/50411307860/r] } @weekdays;

Update: Anagram'd
